endpoints.name: orders_unforbid_all
endpoints.description: Immediately allow all explored forbidden items on this map except insect jelly. Uses the native Allow designator. No item IDs or hauling required. Jelly is skipped, not re-forbidden. Other items near threats are NOT excluded. Returns changed, excluded-jelly and remaining eligible counts.
